name: Jack Lee
summary: Computer Science & Information Technology student and Ericsson intern building Python, Jenkins/Groovy, and Spinnaker tooling for cloud-native CI/CD and Kubernetes/Docker workflows, alongside responsive client web development.

experience.title: Software Engineering Intern
bullets: Contribute to CI/CD delivery for cloud-native services, building Jenkins/Groovy and Spinnaker workflows while supporting Kubernetes, Docker, and Helm/Helmfile infrastructure.
Proposed and implemented a 14-file refactor of a 2,000+ line Python CI module, separating shared and executor-specific decorators and using parameterisation to standardise definitions.
Improved release safety with packaging and Artifactory/Nexus verification; investigate CI/CD infrastructure issues across pipeline integrations.

experience.title: Web Development Intern
bullets: Delivered responsive PHP and SCSS updates across five client sites, translating feedback into accessible, usable page improvements.
Diagnosed and resolved frontend issues across existing sites, improving usability without disrupting established pages.
Collaborated on full-stack website projects through implementation, QA, and release, helping ensure changes were ready for client use.

experience.title: Cashier & Customer Service Representative
bullets: Provided clear, helpful service while handling transactions and resolving customer queries in a high-volume retail setting.
Coordinated with a small team to prioritise tasks, communicate changes, and keep checkout operations running smoothly during busy periods.

projects.title: Deal Ledger
projects.technologies: Hugo, Python, GitHub Actions, Cloudflare Workers, DNS
bullets: Built a responsive Hugo affiliate deal-discovery site with localised interfaces and market-specific routing across English, German, Dutch, and French.
Automated Amazon candidate review, listing and price validation, builds, SEO checks, alert emails, domain and DNS configuration, and Cloudflare routing with Python and GitHub Actions.

projects.title: Multi-Broker Paper Trading Platform
bullets: Built a modular Python paper-trading platform for FX, CFDs, and US equities, separating strategy, execution, risk, market data, journaling, and dashboards.
Integrated IG, Capital.com, and Alpaca paper/demo workflows with SQLite journaling, risk checks, and automated tests.

projects.title: Unity Racing Game
projects.technologies: Unity, C#, NavMesh AI, JSON and CSV persistence
bullets: Built race and hot-lap modes with configurable lap counts, checkpoint validation, timing, reset handling, and a CSV-backed top-10 leaderboard.
Implemented three NavMesh-controlled competitors that follow a 200+ node JSON race path, including corner-speed adjustments and respawn behaviour.
